D+Pad Hero.name: D-Pad Hero
D+Pad Hero.summary: D-Pad Hero is a homebrew for NES based on Guitar Hero.

Dragon Warrior IV.name: Dragon Warrior IV
Dragon Warrior IV.summary: Dragon Warrior IV differs from the rest of the series by breaking up the game into five distinct chapters, each of which focuses on a different protagonist or protagonists. The first four are told from the perspective of the Hero's future companions and the fifth one, from the hero's perspective, brings all the characters together as they begin their journey to save the world.

PROTO DERE .NES.name: Proto Dere .Nes
PROTO DERE .NES.summary:
The creation of the ancient Proto Dere .Nes led to AppSir's modern day hits Dere .Exe and Dere Evil .Exe. For 33 years, the cartridge could not be found.

While not as big as AppSir's modern titles, it was an important artifact that was sought after for decades.

Xenophobe.name: Xenophobe
Xenophobe.summary: The NES port of Xenophobe, a 1987 arcade game. The goal of each level is to defeat all the aliens before time runs out. Levels may contain more than one floor, and players use elevators or holes to move between floors to defeat all of the aliens. Players can also pick up more powerful weapons and other items to help in their eradication of the aliens.
